name: social-media-bridge-for-n8n
description: Chrome extension that connects your logged-in social media sessions to your automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier, self-hosted), on a schedule you control (cron) or on demand.

scripts.zip: cd extension && zip -r -FS ../extension.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' && cd .. && echo 'Wrote extension.zip'
